fieldValues.title: What should a Protocol stage be able to declare?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the minutes runner (Research: Minutes with provenance, part 2). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Extend ProtocolStage: what it reads, which relations it writes, create or update, and checks a tool can run (coverage, limits).
- B. A separate runner-profile definition that packages can carry, leaving Protocol epistemic.
- C. Leave it to tools; publish the conventions as guidance.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether a second tool given the same package runs the process the same way; whether other Protocols (the decision protocol, the unit walk) need the same nine things.
fieldValues.next_action: Run the minutes package with a second runner or by hand through the MCP server, and note where it diverges.
